nom: Beekman 1802 Golden Booster Amla Berry Vitamin C Brightening Serum

avis.texte: I wanted to add a vitamin c serum back into my morning skincare routine and I was recommended this line by an ULTA employee. I have noticed by skin looks brighter and dewy which is what I'm going for. I also have noticed my dark spots are fading. I know that if I keep using the product consistently I'll see my dark spots fade even more. This is gonna be a permanent product in my skincare routine. I love it!

avis.titre: I have been using this product for 3 years now
avis.texte: This is an excellent product! I have recommended this product to all my friends!

avis.titre: Peels and hard to get out
avis.texte: It's thick and really hard to get out of bottle even without syringe . Nothing great , pass!

avis.titre: My skin seems to like it
avis.texte: Only been using for less than 2wks … but so far so good. I have super sensitive skin that has a hard time accepting almost any products.
this stuff pills bad with other products. I went back to my other serum and there was no pilling so I know for sure it was this stuff.

Beekman unlocks the power of clinical kind skincare with this gentle, plant based Vitamin C from the Amala Berry. This ensures that you receive radiance boosting, skin brightening effects without the risk of chemical irritation or reactions. I layer my serum in the AM using my bloom cream and instantly notice how my skin looks rejuvenated and enhanced.

I will start this review by saying I do have sensitive skin. However, I have used a vitamin C serum for years and I have never experienced the redness, burning, and splotchy rash that this serum left me with.

I love this formula! A little goes a long way, i use about 3 drops for my entire face. The product absorbs nicely. I know some people have mentioned a smell, i havent noticed it / it doesnt bother me. I find after using this my skin is softer and does have a beautiful radiance.
I add a drop to my moisturizer and it glides on smooth. My brown spots have faded and my face is now even toned and glowy.

I usually never comment on products but felt I had to for this one since it worked so so great for me and I was pretty surprised to read any negative comments. My skin looked brighter in just a few days, my complexion looks healthier, people keep asking me what is my beauty routine. I algo use their collagen booster and both products work great together, I totally recommend. For reference, I'm 36 yrs old and my skin is normal

i don't have sensitive skin and this product made my skin so red. i used a few drops as directed with moisturizer and my face turned bright red and burned. i tried it with multiple moisturizers and no matter what, the same thing happened.
I really wanted to like this. I finished the entire bottle and I use this with other Beekman products. Absolutely no results. So overpriced for 0.5 oz, seriously expensive for no apparent reason

I had sworn off eye creams under the belief that they were expensive versions in smaller packages of the same heavier creams I wear at night. Something about the hype around this one had me convinced I needed to try one more time...I didn't know I had dark circles until they weren't there anymore. All the texture that had developed under my eyes was gone within maybe 2 weeks! I've already repurchased this once and will continue to do so - IT IS AMAZING
Very light weight Easy to apply. Very resonable price Brightens my face

The ad shows a bright yellow serum. what I'm seeing is that they have changed the formula. First they give us less, now they cheapen it?? I'm not going to rebuy it that's for sure. u lost a customer in me! I feel scammed. Totally wasted my money.

It used to be bright yellow. the bottle u just received is a pale color and the consistency looks totally different. I have bought many in the past, even when they downsized. But now, less product AND a cheaper formula? No thanks. I won't be repurchasing. I would look for a different product.
The vitamin c serum broke out my skin. I tried it a few times with a few days in between. No luck.
I recommend to any and everyone who ask me about how I am keeping my clean clear

avis.titre: Not worth it in my opinion
avis.texte: Very little in the bottle and I do not notice a huge difference in my skin to be honest. Better Vitamin C serum options that are less expensive

This came half full and its already a small bottle. I have had it for less than a month and am almost out. It is not worth it. I cant tell if it is effective because i havent had an opportunity to use it long enough to gauge its effectiveness.

I can't really say I have sensitive skin, nothing I've ever applied before has made me have a reaction but this burn soo bad, my cheeks were super red and I couldnt continue, I had to wash it off. It might be a fine product, just wasnt for me
I used as directed on clean skin with two drops and followed up with a spf moisturizer. It burn so badly. I turned red and blotchy.
this product is so soothing for all skin types will be buying again

I got a small sample of this. I thought at first it like egg yoke and I asked myself, what is this? I absolutely 💯 love it!! I put a little on in the morning and the dullness goes away. My skin looks brighter all day long.;)

Smoothening and brightening for sure and so cute with the moisturizer/bloom cream. Dropping it into the center of the bloom cream to make a perfect flower is satisfying every time.

It doesn't hurt my skin or irritate it, but it's been utterly useless to me. I'm glad it's helped out some people, but I probably won't purchase anymore products from this brand. This was a complete waste of money!
My skin is not sensitive and I've been using vitamin C for years. This IRRITATES my skin.
This product was just okay. Did not brighten my alin like other Vitamin c products I've used.

I have acne-prone and combo/oily skin. I use 2 drops every morning after cleansing and applying the COSRX snail mucin essence and before BOJ sunscreen. After almost 4 months of use, I think it made my skin brighter and helped with evening out skin tone and dark spots. It is fast-absorbing and not greasy, sticky, or heavy. I'm almost done with the bottle, but I probs won't buy it again because it is kinda pricey. However, I recommend it if it is on sale because it's def worth trying!

I use this every morning and I love it, it's my favorite thing to put on. the packaging is beautiful and the dropper is nice size and quality. a little goes a long way. my skin looks brighter and happier for sure. Its first my first vitamin c product so I can't compare it to anything though
Didn't brighten anything and I wanted to like it but the price for the amount and then it doesn't even make a difference makes me want to return this.
My skin drinks it in and it stays on all day..I will buy again.

I've been using this along with the dermalogica exfoliator and I've noticed a difference. My dark spots have gotten lighter and my skin overall seems less dull and a bit brighter.

As a woman who struggles w/ combination skin, this serum truly helps even out my skin tone and dark spots. I have always been hesitant with trying new products because the results were always disappointing. I took the risk. The result was rewarding!
Love this product. Not only does it make your face glow like a kiss from the sun, but it is diminishing the dark spots on my face. Wish I could buy it in gallon size!!!

I've bought this serum from Ulta and I am very happy I did. It is an excellent addition to my routine, it layers well with other products I have and I can notice differences in skin brightness. Will certainly buy this again.

Love the Vitamin C serum! I apply it to the Bloom Moisturizer every night after my shower to my face. Mixed together is so creamy and feels so soft on my face. I love the way it makes my skin feel while I sleep. Not heavy and again it is scent free. I especially love that!

I LOVE this stuff. I used it nightly for a few weeks to help get my skin to a place I was happy with before using a couple times a week for maintenance.. this stuff works wonders for my skin! no awful smell, light, the dropper works great, and a little goes a long way. I have slightly sensitive skin, but not crazy. and combination oily skin. doesn't make me break out, doesn't clog my pores. great at lightening red spots and acne scars. It has helped with my hyper pigmentation on my face, it is clearing it up and making it much less noticeable.

I randomly bought this one day and have used an entire bottle now and absolutely love it. I didn't use a vitamin C serum prior to purchasing this product and I have seen my skin improve drastically. The texture is more smooth, my skin is glowing and bright and I have noticed dark spots from sun or acne have diminished. Definitely repurchasing. Give it a try!
Favorite booster here! I have all the boosters and this one is definitely my fav, I love the way it makes my skin feel and how it clears up certain areas of my face as well

It does not cause my sensitive skin to break out. It actually helped brighten up this redness I have had for a while now. Love it! But I didn't get the best results when using alone. It worked best when used as directed/suggested by dropping only a few drops onto my bloom cream.
Well ...it DOES reduce dark spots related to sun damage and/or acne. Using it daly at night!

First time using this product. Bottle is thick and holds the serum well. Started using the product and so far my dark spots have gotten lighter. My face looks great and when used with the cream even better.

I bought the full serum kit that included 5 of the serums plus the bloom cream and have been using it for three weeks now with no results really disappointed because I bought two of these trusting the boys word. Still love there body cream but the serums going back....

avis.titre: A thrilling interim report update to follow
avis.texte: WDC age 71 In the morning I use the Amla Berry booster with the Milk Drops probiotic ceramide serum as a hydrating base and the Bloom Cream mixed with the Boost. At night I use the Dream Booster blended with the Bloom Cream over my clean and hydrated (with Milk Drops serum} face. My skin was very dry, thin and flaky. Most OTC creams are not hydrating enough and have not helped at all with the flakiness on my forehead and sides of the face. So I am thrilled to find the Beekman 1802 products which are gentle and very effective. I stared using your hand creams in the fall, and the face products in early December. Now, at the New Year, after one of the coldest winters in decades here in the Southern Tier of New York, I no longer experience a constant dryness or loss of hydration or elasticity. There is a lovely glow as well. I still have age spots, so I will let you know if those diminish over time. Thank you all and give a few skritches behind the ears to those fabulous kids you are raising!
Yes, I'm using my product & is giving me a glow on my face. I love the cleaning soap for my face, it's really great & leaves an awesome feel, Thank You for getting in contact with me:hearts:Ô∏è.
I LOVE the easy application of this serum and how it brightens my face. I'm seeing less redness and my brown spots seem to be lighter.

This is the first time I have used this serum. It's kind to my sensative skin and I am noticing an improvement, Visiting family I haven't seen for awhile I received multiple compliments on how nice my skin looks.

I am addicted to your products! The folder booster is just what the doctor ordered form skin. I had run out and with holiday bustle I had been without as I didn''t remember to order. I definitely noticed a change in my skin without it. I am so glad I reordered. It is truly liquid gold!

Happy with the consistency and I like applying it with the bloom cream. I haven't noticed a big difference yet but I've only been using it for about a month.
Love this vitamin c serum! Texture is amazing, goes on, and absorbs perfectly. Is a staple in my morning skincare routine!

I absolutely LOVE all Beekman 1802 products but this one is super nice. The price is extremely fair for the amount of product you get and I only need 1-2 drops mixed in with one pump my Bloom Cream to cover my whole face and even some of my neck. It's a little thicker in my opinion but definitely not too much of an issue :)

I LOVE this serum. I add it to my bloom moisturizer along with the Dream serum and it makes my skin feel and look amazing. It isn't oily or greasy and my skin drank it right up. I am so happy to have found this! Plus its cruelty free which is super important to me!
Used it about a week now and it makes my skin soft and seems to be brighter.

I love having the Golden Booster as part of my routine! It makes my skin radiant, and that is saying a lot when your in your 50's! It is taking care of those fine lines I was starting to see. I also like the glow it gives my skin.

avis.titre: Great addition to my daily routine
avis.texte: This has been a great addition to my daily routine. I use it morning and night with the bloom cream on my face, neck, and upper chest to fade sun damage. It's working great. I add a squirt or two of the body serum into the mix at night for a bit of extra moisturization.
I like the way my skin looks when I apply this with my bloom cream
Does not dry my skin out after I've been dredging it in cream. This THE BEST

Beekman recommended me this product for redness, and I bought it on impulse for Black Friday. I've been using it for almost 3 weeks now, and the results are amazing. Within a few days, I saw a change in how red my skin naturally was. My cheeks were particularly sensitive spots for turning red, which used to embarrass me, but now the redness is toned down and goes away quickly if provoked. I also feel like my skin looks more bright since using this booster. Definitely recommend it to anyone struggling with excessive redness!
Just started using it ‚Äî a drop with my Bloom Cream. Fingers crossed!

So far so good. I haven't used it long enough to make an appropriate review.

I have pretty average skin. Not oily not dry, get occasional breakouts but not regularly. I was dealing with skin tone changes/red areas/under eye darkness when I moved to a new city with bad water and after a challenging year with my health. My skin was getting red spots and was looking very dull especially around my eyes. I used this nightly for a couple weeks and it changed my skin completely! My skin looks more even and much brighter. I usually don't like to spend over $20-$25 on skincare, I'm cheap, but this is so worth it. And it's a clean product which I love. I HIGHLY recommend. Affordable compared to other similar products and you don't need much. I still have about half the product left even after using it so much at first, and now that I have reached a point with my skin that I'm happy with, it's more maintenance and I use it twice a week or so. I wish I had taken before and after because I notice such a big difference in brightness and even tone. Especially brighter under my eyes- which is huge since I have health issues that impact my sleep, which impact the darkness under my eyes. Couldn't be happier. I will DEFINITELY be buying this again.
I liked the way it left my skin feeling soft and dewy. It absorbed quickly which is a huge plus in my book!!!

This serum is so nice, just like the rest of them! I use the milkshake toner, then milk drops, then golden booster, and then mix the collagen and bloom cream and I'm good to go. I have never been able to not wear any makeup in my entire life and I can proudly say I can be barefaced in public with ZERO self-consciousness!
